safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the 3–4 month duration and the specific location/character (sore, cracked, mainly palms) reduces clinical clarity and may broaden/shift the differential (e.g., chronic irritant dermatitis vs other dermatoses) and appropriateness of follow-up. This is unlikely to directly cause injury but can lead to suboptimal management and delayed resolution.
